inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: During review of children's records 1 out of 10 records evaluated did not include emergency medical authorization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink: During the walkthrough of the infant room I observed rubber bibs in the hand washing sink. This was corrected when the caregiver removed the bibs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: During review of children's records 1 out of 10 records evaluated did not include an address for the emergency contact as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: A five month old infant was asleep in a bouncer.      The caregiver removed the five month old child and placed the child in a crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - Six Feet High or Less: The toddler slide does not have 6ft in front of it, the slide is 4ft away from the gate.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - Six Feet High or Less (26 TAC §746.4805(b))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Exits Required: One of the gates on the front playground will not open, the playground only has one working entrance/exit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Exits Required (26 TAC §746.4307)

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Rotating and Rocking Equipment (Sitting): The two rotating and rocking play equipment overlap each other, which it is only 4 1/2 ft of use zone between the two play equipment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Rotating and Rocking Equipment (Sitting) (26 TAC §746.4813(a))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -Provides Sufficient Walking and Work Space: During nap time the operation was found to not have adequate space for caregivers to walk between nap time mats.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -Provides Sufficient Walking and Work Space (26 TAC §746.2909(3))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: During the inspection I observed the ceiling in a classroom to be in need of repair. There was also  evidence of a leak in the ceiling.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: The two infant classrooms are not updating the infant feeding instructions as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: During the inspection I  observed the playground loose-fill material not to be maintained at the proper depth.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: During my walkthrough the teacher in the Infant Room did not know the ages of the children in care.      The cargiver caring for the children in the library did not know the ages of the chidlren in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: During the walk through I observed  five infants not strapped into their highchairs at the table.     Corrected:  The caregiver strapped the kids into their highchair properly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: The child's safety was jeopardized when the director released the child to an unknown/unauthorized person.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Policies for Release of Children Instruct Employees of Verification Plan: The director did not verify the identity of a person who picked up a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies for Release of Children Instruct Employees of Verification Plan (26 TAC §746.4103(c))

occurrences.finding: Policies for Release of Children - Record Identity of Person: The director did not take any measures to record the identity of the unknown person when she released a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies for Release of Children - Record Identity of Person (26 TAC §746.4103(b))

occurrences.finding: Release of Children: The director did not confirm that the person was designated by the parent to pick up the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Release of Children (26 TAC §746.4101)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: The director and other administrative staff are not documenting the days and hours worked. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: Of the 10 personnel records evaluated, 3 completed a CPR training on-line. CPR training  must be taken in-person.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, one was behind with immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: Food allergy plans have not been signed by the doctor and/or parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: Of the 10 personnel records evaluated, 7 lacked signed documentation by either the employee or trainer. that an orientation was completed covering food allergires, adminsitering medications and handling, storing and disposing of hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Reunification Plan: The Emergency Preparedness Plan does not state how children will be reunited with the parent once the emergency is over.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Reunification Plan (26 TAC §746.5202(5))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The Emergency Preparedness Plan does not state how children under 2 years old and with limited mobility will be evacuated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: Of the 10 personnel records evaluated, 4 staff have not completed the 24 clock hours of pre-service training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: There were uncovered outlets in a Pre-K classroom. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))
